chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: It should be obvious now that the value of a dollar delivered in the future,

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: even if it comes from the US government, is worth less than a real dollar right now.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: A real dollar right now is worth $1.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: If I promise to give you a dollar in the future, it's not worth as much.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: So how should we estimate or

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: think about the value of dollars delivered in the future?

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: I think we've also agreed that the United States government promising to give you a dollar

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: in the future is worth a bit more than the promise of Tucker Balch giving you a dollar

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: in the future.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: But having a real dollar in your hand right now, this one is worth the most.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: Why is that?

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: You know intuitively why that is.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: The deeper reason is there's a chance that I won't deliver on that guarantee.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: Whereas we can be pretty sure the US government will deliver on that guarantee.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: So it amounts to risk.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: And it all boils down to interest rate.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: We're trying to figure out the present value or PV of a dollar that will be delivered in

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: the future.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: So it's worth some fraction of this future value.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: Present value is worth some fraction of the future value.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: So here's the formula in its entirety.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: Present value is equal to future value divided by one plus interest rate raised to the I.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: So the I is how far into the future this payment is going to be delivered.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: So for instance if it's going to be delivered right now, I is equal to zero,

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: this whole component becomes one and present value is equal simply to future value.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: In other words if we're going to pay a dollar, present value is worth one dollar.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: If in the future that future is going to be one year from now, it's one plus the interest rate raised

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: to the one power and that is what the future value of that dollar is.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: So let's work out an example.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: Suppose with the United States government because they're so trustworthy,

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: you can negotiate a 1% interest rate.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: Actually as of today, which is 2015, this one year interest rate is only one quarter of a percent.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: In other words interest rates are very, very low.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: If you work it out, the value of a one dollar bill paid to you in the future,

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: one year from now at a 1% interest rate is 99 cents.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: In other words today it's worthwhile for you to pay 99 cents to the U.S. government

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: for the promise that they'll give you a dollar in a year.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: Okay, consider now the Balch bond.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: So it's hard for me to sell you this asset right now for the same price as the U.S. government

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: because if you had to choose between me and the U.S. government for a 1% return,

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: why wouldn't you choose the U.S. government?

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: You should go with the U.S. government because they're more trustworthy than I am.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: So how can I attract you?

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: Well, I can offer you a higher interest rate, let's say 5%.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: And that works out to a value of about 95 cents.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: In other words, in order for me to attract you to buy my promise for a 1 dollar in the future,

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: I could only charge you 95 cents.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: So let's consider this in a chart form.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: So how much is a dollar worth if I promise to give it to you today?

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: Well, in that case this I is equal to 0.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: So the present value is equal to the future value of all this divided by 1.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: So in all cases, if the number of years we're going to wait for the delivery of that dollar is 0,

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: the value is $1.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: But what if we talk about promising you that dollar in the future?

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: If we look at this for the U.S. bond, in one year we see it's worth 99 cents.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: If we carry that forward, it's sort of this exponentially decreasing value like that.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: If you look at the Balch bond, which is of course not as worthwhile as the U.S. government,

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: you see one that decreases at an even faster rate.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: So in other words, at each year in the future, this $1 is worth less.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: In other words, if I promise to give you a dollar in two years, it's worth less than if I promise to give you a dollar in a year,

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: it's worth even less than if I promise to give you the dollar right now.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: And these charts are different depending on what the interest rate is.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
chunks.text: In other words, for the higher interest rate assets, they decrease further into the future.

chunks.title: The value of a future dollar
